question: We consider the relation “a person $x$ shakes hand with a person $y$”. Obviously, if $x$ shakes hand with $y$, then $y$ shakes hand with $x$. In a gathering of 99 persons, one of the following statements is always true, considering 0 to be an even number. Which one is it?

options.A: There is at least one person who shakes hand exactly with an odd number of persons.
options.B: There is at least one person who shakes hand exactly with an even number of persons.
options.C: There are even number of persons who shake hand exactly with an even number of persons.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
